d: Boston medical examiner Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and police officer Woody Holt (Jerry O'Connell) come to the Montecito hot on the trail of a murder and a missing rare violin.
Ed and Danny have 12 hours to save Delinda from her kidnappers  Mike and Sam try to figure out whether a Buddhist monk's major winning-streak is a scam.
A blacklisted mobster (Vincent Pastore) purchases the Montecito's million-dollar wedding package, including Wayne Newton, for his daughter, but problems arise because Wayne is on bad terms with Ed.
Everyone reluctantly participates in Ed's Secret Santa gift exchange  Danny's car is stolen on Christmas Eve  Delinda eagerly plans her first Christmas with Danny.
Minutes before a rare wine discovered in the Montecito's cellar is auctioned off for $1 million, Mike realizes it is not genuine  a group of retirees checks into the hotel for a Sudoku tournament.

One of Ed's favorite former employees (Kate Levering) returns with her husband (Judd Nelson) to celebrate her wedding anniversary at the Montecito  Mary and Sam disagree about which guests are most important and fight for OK Go's time.
Ed, Danny and Mike bet on who can find the most waste at the Montecito  Mary must sell the last residential suite and hopes to entice big money with a performance by John Legend.
